findings.title: Nested loop may indicate super-linear work on a hot path
findings.recommendation: Confirm the collection sizes; if they grow with load, consider a set/dict lookup or precomputed index to cut CPU time (lowers E).

findings.title: Blocking sleep() holds a worker/thread idle
findings.recommendation: Prefer event-driven waits or async scheduling so the worker can be reclaimed while idle.
findings.slo_risk: None if replaced with an equivalent async wait; verify retry/backoff semantics are preserved.

findings.title: SELECT * pulls unused columns over the wire
findings.recommendation: Select only needed columns; reduces I/O, network and serialization energy per query.

findings.title: Full-fat base image inflates embodied + transfer footprint
findings.recommendation: Switch to a slim/distroless/alpine base or a multi-stage build; smaller images pull faster and use less registry storage and cold-start energy (M, E).

findings.title: Build toolchain shipped in the runtime image
findings.recommendation: Use a multi-stage build so compilers/build deps do not ship in the final image.

findings.title: Container runs as root (no USER directive)
findings.recommendation: Add a non-root USER. Sustainability-adjacent hardening; does not change carbon directly.

findings.title: Workload has no CPU/memory requests or limits
findings.recommendation: Set requests/limits so the scheduler can bin-pack efficiently instead of stranding node capacity (M, E).
findings.slo_risk: Set limits from observed p99 usage, not guesses; limits set too low can throttle or OOM-kill under load.

findings.title: Workflow declares no dependency caching
findings.recommendation: Cache dependencies (actions/cache or setup-*'s cache) so every run does not re-download and rebuild from scratch (E).

findings.title: Pipeline runs on every push with no path filter
findings.recommendation: Add path filters or concurrency cancellation so docs-only or superseded commits do not trigger full builds.

findings.title: No concurrency control; superseded runs are not cancelled
findings.recommendation: Add a concurrency group with cancel-in-progress so an outdated run stops when a newer commit lands.

findings.title: Scheduled (cron) workflow runs regardless of changes
findings.recommendation: Confirm the schedule is needed; nightly builds on quiet repos burn compute with no functional output.

pillars.label: Cloud Infrastructure Choices

findings.title: Deploys to a relatively high-carbon region (us-east-1)
findings.recommendation: If latency/data-residency allow, prefer a lower-carbon region. Region choice directly changes carbon intensity I in SCI.
findings.slo_risk: Region moves affect latency and data residency; validate compliance and RTO/RPO before relocating.
findings.ghg_scope: GHG Protocol Scope 3 Category 1 (purchased cloud services).

findings.title: Fixed capacity with no effective autoscaling (min == max)
findings.recommendation: Add a target-tracking scaling policy and let min < max so capacity follows demand instead of running peak-sized 24/7 (large E win).
findings.slo_risk: Configure min capacity and scale-out cooldowns to protect availability during spikes.

findings.title: Very large instance type declared (m5.12xlarge)
findings.recommendation: Confirm the workload needs this size; right-size from observed utilization, and prefer current-gen (e.g. Graviton/ARM) for better performance-per-watt.

findings.title: Deployment without a HorizontalPodAutoscaler
findings.recommendation: Add an HPA so replica count tracks load rather than sitting at a fixed count around the clock.
findings.slo_risk: Set sensible min replicas and stabilization windows to avoid flapping under bursty load.

notes: Declared infrastructure found -> cloud findings evaluated at Tier 2 (static + declared infra).

findings.title: No observability/metrics stack detected in manifests
findings.recommendation: Instrument with metrics (utilization, request rate, saturation). You cannot right-size or prove an efficiency win you cannot measure. This is the precondition for reaching Tier 3.

findings.title: Deployment without liveness/readiness probes
findings.recommendation: Add probes so the platform can route around and reclaim unhealthy pods rather than wasting capacity on them.
findings.slo_risk: None; probes improve resiliency. Tune thresholds to avoid premature restarts.
